tests.name: badges: 3 sensors with a hot CPU, 1 sensor, PC off

steps.js: S.cards = await T.card.rendered('ha-plooum-pc-card', 6); S.card = (name) => S.cards.find((c) => c._name === name); S.badges = (c, where) => deep(c.shadowRoot, `.temps.${where} .temp`).map((e) => e.textContent.trim() + (e.classList.contains('hot') ? '!' : '')).join(); S.bureau = S.card('bureau'); S.ia = S.card('IA'); S.nas = S.card('NAS'); await waitFor(() => S.bureau._found.temps.length === 3 && S.ia._found.temps.length === 1 && S.nas._found.temps.length === 4, 10000, 'sensors found');

steps.msg: the temperature sensors are found on the sensor's device
bureau: hot CPU at the top
bureau: GPU then disk at the bottom
badge icons
ia: one CPU badge (47.5 rounds to 48)
no badge while the PC is off

steps.assert: (() => { const r = S.bureau.shadowRoot.querySelector('ha-card').getBoundingClientRect(); const t = S.bureau.shadowRoot.querySelector('.temps.top').getBoundingClientRect(); const b = S.bureau.shadowRoot.querySelector('.temps.bottom').getBoundingClientRect(); return t.top < r.top && t.bottom > r.top && b.top < r.bottom && b.bottom > r.bottom && t.left < r.left + r.width / 2 && b.right > r.left + r.width / 2; })()
steps.msg: badges straddle the top edge (left) and the bottom edge (right)

steps.assert: deep(S.bureau.shadowRoot, '.temp').map((e) => e.title).join('|') === 'CPU temperature: 86.4 °C (hot)|GPU temperature: 54.2 °C|Disk nvme0 temperature: 41 °C'
steps.msg: each badge says what it measures on hover
the badges get the pointer (so the tooltip shows)
a click on a badge still opens the dialog

tests.name: dialog: one cell per sensor, a tap opens its more-info

steps.js: S.cards = await T.card.rendered('ha-plooum-pc-card', 6); S.bureau = S.cards.find((c) => c._name === 'bureau'); await waitFor(() => S.bureau._found.temps.length === 3, 10000, 'sensors found'); S.bureau.shadowRoot.querySelector('ha-card').click(); S.cells = () => deep(S.bureau.dialogRoot, '.temps .temp');

steps.msg: CPU (hot), GPU and disk cells under the state
Restart and Shut down are still there
a tap on the CPU cell opens its more-info dialog
the card's dialog closed

tests.name: NAS on: hottest disk, forced sensors and thresholds, back off

steps.js: S.cards = await T.card.rendered('ha-plooum-pc-card', 6); S.card = (name) => S.cards.find((c) => c._name === name); S.badges = (c, where) => deep(c.shadowRoot, `.temps.${where} .temp`).map((e) => e.textContent.trim() + (e.classList.contains('hot') ? '!' : '')).join(); S.nas = S.card('NAS'); S.disks = S.card('NAS disks'); await T.card.call('button', 'press', { entity_id: 'button.nas_wake_on_lan' }); await T.card.waitState('sensor.nas_temperature_cpu', (s) => s.state !== 'unavailable', 10000);

steps.msg: nas: CPU at the top
nas: 4 sensors, 3 badges: the hottest disks (sdb hot from 55 °C)
forced sensors, max_temps 2, hot_disk_temp 35
the dialog lists every sensor

steps.js: S.nas._close(); await T.card.call('button', 'press', { entity_id: 'button.nas_eteindre' }); await T.card.waitState('binary_sensor.nas_en_ligne', (s) => s.state === 'off', 10000);

steps.msg: the badges go away when the PC shuts down

finally.js: if (S.nas) S.nas._close(); if (T.hass().states['binary_sensor.nas_en_ligne'].state === 'on') await T.card.call('button', 'press', { entity_id: 'button.nas_eteindre' });

steps.js: S.cards = await T.card.rendered('ha-plooum-pc-card', 6); S.bureau = S.cards.find((c) => c._name === 'bureau'); S.badges = (c) => deep(c.shadowRoot, '.temp').map((e) => e.textContent.trim()).join(); await waitFor(() => S.bureau._found.temps.length === 3, 10000, 'sensors found'); S.gpu = T.hass().states['sensor.bureau_temperature_gpu']; await T.hass().callApi('POST', 'states/sensor.bureau_temperature_gpu', { state: 'unavailable', attributes: S.gpu.attributes });

steps.msg: no badge for an unavailable sensor

steps.js: S.config = S.bureau.config; S.bureau.setConfig({ ...S.config, max_temps: 0 }); await S.bureau.updateComplete;

steps.msg: max_temps: 0 hides the badges
the dialog still shows the available sensors

steps.js: const ed = document.createElement('ha-plooum-pc-card-editor'); ed.hass = T.hass(); ed.setConfig({ entity: 'binary_sensor.bureau_en_ligne' }); document.body.append(ed); await ed.updateComplete; S.schema = JSON.stringify(ed.shadowRoot.querySelector('ha-form').schema); ed.remove();

steps.msg: the editor has the temperature options

finally.js: if (S.bureau) { S.bureau._close(); if (S.config) S.bureau.setConfig(S.config); } if (S.gpu) await T.hass().callApi('POST', 'states/sensor.bureau_temperature_gpu', { state: S.gpu.state, attributes: S.gpu.attributes });
